name: Luminous Ward
disable: DC 40 Thievery check (master) to disable the wards or Dispel Magic (9th rank; counteract DC 38) to counteract the ward

items.name: Radiant Explosion
items.text:
Trigger A creature touches the door

---

Effect All creatures within 20 feet of the door are scorched with brilliant light, taking 20d6 fire damage (DC 40 basic Reflex save save). A creature that fails this save is Blinded for 1 hour (or permanently on a critical failure).

text: A burst of radiance explodes from the door.
